documentation.content: The HATVP pipeline has produced warning-bearing snapshots consecutively. Review the quality report and quarantine records before the next weekly run.

conditions.displayName: quality warning streak reached two snapshots

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id = "yahatvp-pipeline-eu" AND resource.labels.location = "europe-west1" AND resource.labels.job_name = "hatvp-ingestion" AND jsonPayload.event = "quality_warning_streak" AND jsonPayload.warning_streak >= 2
